title_en: What do you miss about your country?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Sarah. I come from England. And my question is what do you miss about your home country?

So currently I am living in Thailand. I've been living here for the past six years now, six, seven years. And yeah, I love it here, but there's definitely things I miss about England, first of all, my friends and my family, of course. I think that is the main thing, especially when it comes to Christmas, birthdays, any type of holiday, New Year, anything. I really start to miss home. And I even miss the cold weather and the snow when it gets to Christmas time, which I'd never thought I'd say about England.

But yeah, I think it's a lot more festive at home during holidays and especially when you're surrounded by your loved ones. So yeah, definitely the biggest thing I miss at home is friends, family, and sharing the holidays together.
